payload.claim: The dropped-finding reason embeds `head` as the packaged head and `graded_head` as the graded head, per the acceptance criterion's required phrasing ('between the packaged head and the graded head'). The new test only asserts that both full shas appear somewhere in the reason string (`assert built.shas["H2"] in reason` and `assert built.shas["R2"] in reason`), never that each sha is attached to the correct role. Swapping which variable fills which half of the sentence keeps both shas present and the test green, while the emitted explanation would misname which head is the packaged one and which is the graded one.
